answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 3465 Country: India Title: jin aurton se boso kinar kiya gaya ho unki aulad se shadi kaisi hai chahe aurat ki kitni bhi umar ho Question: jin aurton se boso kinar kiya gaya ho unki aulad se shadi kaisi hai chahe aurat ki kitni bhi umar ho Answer ID: 3465 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 262/248=J) It is haram for a person to marry the daughter of a woman whom he has kissed with lust ( shahwah ). If he marries any of her female offspring the nikah will never be valid however aged she might have be: وحرم أیضاً بالصھریۃ أصل ممسوستہ الخ و فروعھن مطلقاً ھذا اذا کانت حیۃ مشتھاۃ و لو ماضیاً کعجوز شوھاء لأنھا دخلت تحت الحرمۃ فلا تخرج ( الشامی: 4/110 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
